categories.main_business_segments: Henan Liliang Diamond Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of synthetic diamond products including diamond single crystals, diamond micro powders, and cultivated diamonds. The company operates multiple production bases and focuses on high-tech synthetic diamond materials and jewelry-grade cultivated diamonds.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) synthesis technology with large cavity six-sided press machines for diamond single crystal and cultivated diamond production. It has proprietary technologies in raw material formulation, new sealing pressure media manufacturing, large cavity synthesis, high-grade cultivated diamond synthesis, and diamond micro powder preparation. The company also invests in R&D for functional diamond materials with applications in electronics and semiconductors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial tool manufacturers, semiconductor and electronics companies, jewelry manufacturers, and downstream users in aerospace, defense, automotive, and new energy sectors. The cultivated diamonds serve both industrial applications and the jewelry market, with growing demand domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Henan province and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Beijing, and other Chinese cities. It also has a presence in the United States through a wholly-owned subsidiary. Sales are distributed between domestic and international markets, with significant export activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henan Liliang Diamond operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the synthetic diamond supply chain, producing core synthetic diamond materials and finished cultivated diamonds. It also engages in some upstream activities by producing raw diamond single crystals used internally for micro powder production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation focusing on improving synthesis efficiency, product quality, and expanding applications of synthetic diamonds in emerging fields such as third-generation semiconductors, 5G/6G communications, photovoltaics, and new energy vehicles. It invests in R&D for high-purity diamond powders, large-size cultivated diamonds, and functional diamond materials, supported by multiple provincial and national research platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of synthetic diamond products including diamond single crystals, micro powders, and cultivated diamonds. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distribution channels, with pricing strategies based on market demand, competition, and production costs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic synthetic diamond industry, especially in the cultivated diamond segment and specialized diamond micro powders for IC chip processing. It competes with other major Chinese synthetic diamond producers and international players, leveraging its advanced technology, product quality, and comprehensive product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 686 million, a decrease of 8.74% from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 201 million, down 44.79%. Despite revenue decline, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company has expanded production capacity and continues to invest heavily in R&D and production facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Henan Liliang Diamond emphasizes its advanced synthesis technology, high product quality, and diversified product portfolio including high-grade cultivated diamonds and specialized diamond powders. Its integrated production of diamond single crystals and micro powders creates synergistic advantages, enhancing product value and market responsiveness. The company also highlights its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and strategic location in China's leading diamond industry cluster.
